output_list.reason: Allows arbitrary contract to transfer token from the user. In worst case scenario, arbitrary contract can transfer the whole supply to its attacker, thereby devalue the token. If token is intended to be used for value exchange, attacker can easily transfer the value to the attacker and keep all the supply of the token in attacker's account. Also if the token has high transaction cost, attacker could make his token as cheap to trade as other token.
